hints.title: Level-Wise Independence
hints.text: Swaps can only be performed between nodes that reside at the exact same tree level. Each tree level can be analyzed completely independently.

hints.title: Level Order Extraction
hints.text: Perform a breadth-first level order traversal to collect the values present at each depth.

hints.title: Permutation Cycle Swaps
hints.text: For each level array, minimum swaps required to sort an array equals array length minus the number of disjoint permutation cycles.

hints.title: Level BFS and Cycle Counting Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in binary tree
complexity.notes: Sorting values at each level takes O(L log L) per level, summing to O(n log n) overall.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy selection swapping without cycle detection risks sub-optimal moves or quadratic simulation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary queue and visited tracking memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines level-order breadth traversal with permutation cycle decomposition to count minimum swaps.
